motivation: Re-review critique: the headline ColQwen2.5 v0.1->v0.2 transition is replayable only after pinning the released processor. ColQwen2 v0.1->v1.0 is the one official release pair whose two versions ship the same base and the same processor (max_pixels 602,112 in both adapter packages), so it is a public upgrade that is legal exactly as released. This run repeats the pooled-gallery upgrade matrix for it under the released contract.

colqwen2-v1.0.kind: same-vendor official release, same base and processor as shipped

processor: Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct processor with max_pixels 602,112, the value both released adapter packages ship. No pinning is needed: the released v0.1 and v1.0 contracts are identical.
gallery: Identical to pooled-gallery-upgrade-matrix-v1 after its amendments: 3,420 distinct pages (six ViDoRe collections + 580 MMDocIR distractors), 1,033 holdout queries from the five collections with a query on every row; calibration 16 pages per collection; bridges fitted on non-holdout queries with text; hot-refresh at the matched suffix share, 25% and 50%.
exactness_check: On the first 40 gallery pages the exact BF16 cut's terminal vectors are compared elementwise with the target's own encode: max absolute error and the number of bitwise-identical pages are recorded.

predictions_frozen_before_output.C1_exact: Exact-cut TA@10 = 1.000 and the exact-cut terminal vectors are bitwise identical to the target's on at least 38 of 40 checked pages (max abs error otherwise <= 1e-2 in bf16).
predictions_frozen_before_output.C2_stale_breaks: Stale-index TA@10 <= .60 and top-1 flip rate >= .25 on the pooled gallery (per-collection holdouts gave .48-.76).
predictions_frozen_before_output.C3_operating_point: PCA-512 keeps TA@10 >= .85 with nDCG@5 within .01 of the target; PCA-256 either fails the .01 floor or has TA@10 < .80, so the admitted point differs from ColQwen2.5's.
predictions_frozen_before_output.C4_leverage: Cut leverage under the released 602k contract lies in [.78, .92] (Qwen2-VL-2B has a 600M vision tower before a 1.5B decoder).

claim_boundary: One official release pair on one 2B base, single-gold-page relevance, one A100, batch 1. This is the same-processor complement to the ColQwen2.5 matrix, not a replacement for it.
